If you've been turned down for furniture financing somewhere else in Louisville, you're not alone. Most big furniture stores only offer Synchrony or their own store credit card — and if your credit isn't great, you get denied. That's it. They move on to the next customer.

We don't work like that.

How Bubba's Handles Financing Differently

We have four different financing partners. If one says no, we try the next one. Most of our customers get approved by at least one.

Option 1: Progressive Leasing

No credit check. They look at your bank account and income instead. $49 gets you started, and you have 90 days to pay it off with no interest. If you need more time, payments spread over 12 months.

Option 2: Acima

Same idea — no credit check, based on your bank account. Only $25 to start, which is the lowest down payment we offer. 90 days same as cash.

Option 3: Koalifi

No credit needed, $50 down, and you get 100 days to pay it off interest-free — the longest window of any of our options. Plus Koalifi reports your payments to TransUnion, so making payments on time actually helps rebuild your credit.

Option 4: Synchrony

This one does require a credit check. If your credit is decent, Synchrony offers 0% interest promos for 6-60 months. Best terms out of all four if you qualify.

What You Need to Apply

  • Valid ID
  • A checking account at a traditional bank (not online-only banks or prepaid cards)
  • Proof of income (bank statements showing deposits)
  • Your Social Security number

That's it. No minimum credit score. No cosigner needed.

What Can You Finance?

Everything. Sectionals, sofas, recliners, bedroom sets, mattresses, dining tables, outdoor furniture — anything in the store. No minimum purchase. If we sell it, you can finance it.

How Long Does Approval Take?

Usually under 5 minutes. You can apply online before you come in, or do it at the store. Either way, you'll know your approval amount right away.

Can I Still Get Approved If I Was Denied Somewhere Else?

Probably. The big stores usually only have one financing option. If Synchrony says no, they're out of options. We have three no-credit-needed alternatives that don't even look at your credit score.
